periods.label: 被夺走道场的绫辻一刀流继承人
titles: 破军学园三年一班学生骑士
绫辻一刀流继承人候补

status.selection_battle_record: 10 wins before losing to Ikki; disqualified after self-reporting cheating
status.family: Kaito Ayatsuji's daughter; dojo restored after Kuraudo concedes it

appearance.overview: Black-haired, well-mannered upperclassman with a shy bearing and trained swordswoman's body.
distinctive: stern focus when holding a sword

personality.summary: Earnest, modest and deeply filial; grief and urgency drive her into dishonorable tactics, but her sword and conscience reject betraying her father's teachings.
fears: Kaito dying while trapped in regret
being unable to reclaim the dojo
personality.inner_conflict: She believes only results can save her father, yet her soul cannot accept victory won by abandoning dignity.

quote_samples: 请你教我！我非得变强不可！

background.upbringing: Raised in a small Ayatsuji Itto-ryu dojo among Kaito and a handful of disciples.
formative_events: received Kaito's ruby-red Device Hidzume training and saw Ten'i Muhou
saw Kuraudo defeat Kaito, take the dojo, and break the disciples two years earlier
repeatedly challenged Kuraudo after the dojo was stolen

relationships.ikki-kurogane: Teacher, opponent, then trusted friend who restores her dignity and helps reclaim the dojo.
relationships.stella-vermillion: Becomes confidante after teasing out Stella and Ikki's relationship at the pool.
relationships.kuraudo-kurashiki: Enemy who stole the dojo; she vows to defeat him herself someday.

knowledge: Kaito's teaching that power without dignity is violence
details of Kuraudo's duel with Kaito
Ikki and Stella are secretly dating
secrets: Forces Ikki to spend Ittou Shura before their match and pre-sets Reppu Soukon traps
periods.summary: Ayase stalks Ikki because she wants sword instruction but is too shy to ask. Ikki recognizes her lineage and corrects her body mechanics. After being paired against him, she cheats out of desperation to reach Kuraudo and reclaim her father's dojo. Ikki defeats her without rejecting her, forcing her to admit she wants help. She self-reports her cheating, loses selection eligibility, and after Ikki's duel with Kuraudo learns Kaito's true feelings and regains a path toward becoming his successor.

key_events.summary: Ayase becomes Ikki's sword student after a week of awkward stalking.
She lures Ikki to the roof and jumps so he must spend Ittou Shura saving her.
She uses illegal Reppu Soukon traps but loses to Ikki and accepts help.
Ikki wins back the dojo and shows her Kaito's true warrior spirit.
Ayase is suspended for self-reporting; Kaito awakens and jokes about marrying her to Ikki.
